skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Consolidate knowledge on Law of International Trade including its contents and practical applications.
Gradually familiarize with field agencies in the area of Law of International Trade.
Gradually identify and solve problems related to Law of International Trade.
Develop research, analysis, and synthesis skills for issues related to Law of International Trade.
Ability to work independently and in groups to solve issues related to Law of International Trade.
Ability to self-study and understand real-world situations to solve assigned issues related to Law of International Trade.
Awareness of classroom discipline, adherence to class rules, and personal responsibility for activities assigned by instructors.
